title: R’ Ami bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman identifies him as the well-known Rami bar Chama and says the Jerusalem Talmud always calls him Ami bar Chama. He finds the Ami form in the Bavli as well, in [Pesachim 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.27b.1) and [Ketubot 48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.48b.13).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted texts have Rav Ami in Pesachim and Rabbi Ami in Ketubot. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=596&lang=en) also refers to Rami bar Chama and gives its own account of the variation in the Jerusalem Talmud.
